Resolves #21793

🌿 A select can no longer break the label column it stands in.

`Neo.form.field.Select` gains TextField's `labelPosition` (`'top'` by default, or `'left'`) and `labelWidth` (150), and the timeline editor's Resource field uses `'left'`. In the scheduler's editor it now starts in the label column of Title, Start, End and Progress, and the dialog is 20 px shorter. A left label adds `label-left`, and `Select.css` lays the field out as two columns with the error under the select. An existing select renders as before.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e and a component spec, red on base and green at the head) → L3 required (the layout comes from `Select.css`, measured in the rendered editor). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 Resource's label and select start where Title's do, at 1280 and 390 px | `e2e/scheduler/EventEditor.spec.mjs` › "the Room select has its label beside it, in the column of the other fields, at both sizes" (the example names the field Room), at 1440 and 390 px. Base: `Received: 150` px off. CI: e2e-engine. |
| AC-2 a select without `labelPosition` renders as before; CardEditor unchanged | `unit/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` › the new test's first part (no `label-left`, no label width); `e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs`, `e2e/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs`, `e2e/rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs`. CI: unit, e2e-engine. |
| AC-3 `labelPosition` switches at runtime; any other value keeps the current one | `unit/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` › "the label sits above by default, beside the select at labelWidth for left, and an unknown position keeps the current one". CI: unit. |
| AC-4 with its label left, a select's error shows under the select | `component/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` (new). Base: `Expected: 150`, `Received: 400` (the label took the field's width). CI: components. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Only `'left'` adds a class (`label-left`). Top is the field's own layout, so an existing select keeps its class list.
- AC-1 runs at 1440 px, the spec's desktop size, rather than 1280.
- `labelWidth` sizes the label's grid column, not the label (b4b802835f, from Euclid's pre-review probe): a percentage then resolves against the field as in a TextField, 150 px for 37.5% of 400 px where the first head drew 16 px. A hidden label sets no column, and the field's own style is merged.

## Test Evidence
The whole page with the editor open, `examples/scheduler/eventEditor` in neo-dark, base `dev` on the left and the head on the right (frames from commit `5e4813754b`, removed again in `65b3079c3f`):

| | Base (`dev`) | Head |
|---|---|---|
| 1440 × 900 | ![base 1440](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/5e4813754b673078d3e2992519fdc90031afdd30/review-evidence/21793/before-1440.png?raw=true) | ![head 1440](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/5e4813754b673078d3e2992519fdc90031afdd30/review-evidence/21793/after-1440.png?raw=true) |
| 390 × 844 | ![base 390](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/5e4813754b673078d3e2992519fdc90031afdd30/review-evidence/21793/before-390.png?raw=true) | ![head 390](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/5e4813754b673078d3e2992519fdc90031afdd30/review-evidence/21793/after-390.png?raw=true) |

Frame critique: Room's label now stands in the label column, and its select starts and ends with Title's input; the dialog is 20 px shorter at both sizes (311 → 291 px at 1440, 401 → 381 px at 390). At 390 px, Start and End still put their time on a second line, as on base (out of scope). Nothing else on the page changed.
